title: South Florida Weekend Guide, Halloween Season Starts Early
igCaption:
Halloween season is already moving across South Florida, with Miami New Times tracking 11 pop-up bars and events this October.
This weekend also has a South Florida Top 10 list with chocolate and whiskey, freestyle music, and SummerFest.
Tell us what we should cover next.

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami, Sun Sentinel, The Miami Guide, Mommy Poppins

#MiamiEvents #SouthFloridaEvents #HalloweenMiami #WeekendGuide

scenes.text: Halloween season already started in South Florida, and one October guide lists eleven pop-up bars and events.
Miami New Times counted eleven Halloween pop-up bars and food events across Miami and Fort Lauderdale for October 2026. The lineup includes vampire dinners, murder mysteries, and spooky cocktails.
